reasoning_content: (Internal note: I accidentally included a `description` field that isn't in the tool's schema. Retrying with only `summary` and `command`.)

action.command:
cd /workspace
for port in 18005 18007 18008; do
  line=$(grep -n "\-\-port $port " process-compose.yaml | head -1 | cut -d: -f1)
  echo "=== port $port @ line $line ==="
  awk -v l="$line" 'NR<=l && /name:/ {n=$0} END{print n}' process-compose.yaml
done
echo "--- context around 18005 ---"
sed -n '178,200p' process-compose.yaml

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments:
{"command": "cd /workspace
for port in 18005 18007 18008; do
  line=$(grep -n "\-\-port $port " process-compose.yaml | head -1 | cut -d: -f1)
  echo "=== port $port @ line $line ==="
  awk -v l="$line" 'NR<=l && /name:/ {n=$0} END{print n}' process-compose.yaml
done
echo "--- context around 18005 ---"
sed -n '178,200p' process-compose.yaml", "summary": "Show port-to-service mapping context", "security_risk": "LOW"}
